summary: Migrated the dynamic-kernel document pack, promoted TASK-0021..TASK-0032 into authoritative AWKP task records, reconciled old TASK-0011..TASK-0020 backlog records, and published baseline inventory/drift evidence without introducing runtime behavior.
known_limitations: The external pack README was not allowed to overwrite the existing project README; it was preserved as AHRA-DYNAMIC-KERNEL-DOCUMENT-PACK-README.md. TASK-0022 must update the real README deliberately.
The two imported master-plan root files are byte-identical in the source pack; the actual task sequence is TASK-SEQUENCE.md and work/proposed/TASK-SEQUENCE.md.
Baseline checks were executed after document migration and lint boundary correction, not before all file edits. The initial repo git status was clean before migration.
Dynamic Goal/Claim/Gate/PlanIR runtime behavior is not implemented by TASK-0021 and remains assigned to TASK-0023 onward.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Machine-readable component inventory covers default-visible package, commands, Skills, adapters, contract families, active architecture documents, and active tasks.
Each inventory entry names owner, lifecycle class, entrypoints, consumers, tests, served Core Objects, and replacement/removal information.
Baseline command results and environment limitations are preserved as Evidence.
Drift report distinguishes implemented, partially implemented, documented-only, duplicate, and dead or legacy paths.
TASK-0011 through TASK-0020 have append-only reconciliation outcomes and no history rewrite.
No file is deleted and no new runtime behavior is introduced.
Proposed task IDs are confirmed or remapped atomically.

verification.summary: scripts/lint_contracts.py returned 0; unittest discovery ran 70 tests in 37.068s and returned OK.
verification.limitation: Executed after document-pack migration and lint boundary edit, but before runtime/code behavior changes; initial git status before migration was clean.
The lint now treats work/proposed/tasks/*.md as non-authoritative drafts so promoted task IDs are not double-counted.
